text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring). Any Umamusume who runs well in this race
will undoubtedly carve her name into history as one of the truly strong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before the prestigious mantle of the Shield—Kitasan Black stood tall and faced it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Here comes the second hurdle! This might
very well be the biggest peak of the spring.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if I run a good race here,
everyone will have to acknowledge that I'm a strong Umamusume, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A good race here will lead straight
into the Takarazuka Kinen, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it directly ties into your popularity, too!
Yeah, it directly ties into your popularity too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume with both substance and brilliance. Showing her substance here
will undoubtedly lead to her brilliance blooming.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Allllright, here I go! I'll take on this
huge mountain head-on...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll push through! With all my hidden strength!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black stood in the paddock.
Two shadows watched over her gallant figure.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black... A tenacious Umamusume, but last year, she lacked that sense of "dread."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Brusqueman, you had best watch closely.
And see whether she is someone you can afford to overlook.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto's 3200m will make it clear.
Just what kind of Umamusume she has become.
